name: Berserker Alpha
description: A veteran commander who quaffs magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.

abilities.name: Pack Fury
abilities.description: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack’s target.

abilities.name: Bark at the Moon
abilities.description: Once per scene, spend a Fear to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

abilities.name: Berserker Rage
abilities.description: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.
